name: pass-passwords
title: Pass Passwords
description: Manage pass passwords, metadata, generation, and encrypted records
author: sky-bro

commands.name: passwords
commands.title: Passwords
commands.subtitle: pass
commands.description: Search, create, edit, generate, move, and copy pass passwords

preferences.name: storePath
preferences.title: Password Store
preferences.description: Absolute path or ~/path. Leave empty for PASSWORD_STORE_DIR or ~/.password-store.

preferences.name: clipboardSeconds
preferences.title: Clipboard Lifetime (Seconds)
preferences.description: 1–99999 seconds. Leave empty for PASSWORD_STORE_CLIP_TIME or 45 seconds.

preferences.name: defaultLength
preferences.title: Generated Password Length
preferences.description: Default length for the generator, from 1 to 1024.

preferences.name: includeSymbols
preferences.title: Password Characters
preferences.description: Include symbols in generated passwords by default.
preferences.label: Include symbols by default

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Enter Action
preferences.description: Choose whether Enter copies, browses fields, types the password/OTP, or types username → Tab → password.

preferences.name: lastUsedSeconds
preferences.title: Recent Entry Lifetime
preferences.description: Pin the last used entry for this many seconds. Use 0 to disable metadata storage.

preferences.name: fileSchema
preferences.title: Field Schema (Optional JSON)
preferences.description: An ordered array of key/type objects. Types: password, field, note, otp. Leave empty for automatic parsing.
